tier_reason: First-party Evaluation.md compares Darts-clone 0.32g with the original Darts using the repo's own src/darts-benchmark.cc, and names gcc 4.3.3 and a Core 2 Quad Q9550, but optimization flags are not stated (configure.ac sets only -Wall -Weffc++), so it falls short of A; no independent measurement found.

corrections.claimed_speedup: Random-order exactMatchSearch: JA1 170.4 vs 76.2 ns/key (about 2.2x faster, derived from page data), EN1 228.5 vs 111.3 ns/key (about 2.1x, derived from page data), EN3 545.3 vs 453.3 ns/key. Lexicographic exactMatchSearch: JA1 48.9 vs 33.1 ns/key. Dictionary size about halved (JA1 7,023 KB vs 3,336 KB; EN2 513,873 KB vs 240,634 KB). Build time lower when no values are given (JA1 828 vs 368 ns/key), but higher when every key has a unique value (JA1 1,196 ns/key, EN2 6,666 vs 2,518 ns/key).
corrections.caveats: Baseline is the original Darts, not SDSL or sux. Numbers are from a 2009-2011 era machine and compiler (gcc 4.3.3, Darts-clone 0.32g), on a Japanese-language page; optimization flags are not stated. Results are mixed: on the postal-code set (DIG) Darts-clone is slower for exactMatchSearch (24.2 vs 18.8 ns/key lexicographic, 43.9 vs 40.2 random), and lexicographic traverse() is slower on every word list (for example JA2 144.6 vs 119.1 ns/key); the page attributes this to traverse() not being inlined. Build time is lower only when no values are associated; with unique values per key, build is slower than Darts on every corpus (for example EN2 6,666 vs 2,518 ns/key). The page itself warns that search time depends heavily on cache sizes, inlining and key distribution. On the large Wikipedia and n-gram sets the random-order gain is smaller (JA2 516.4 vs 620.8 ns/key). Found as a registry hit, but it is a compact trie rather than a rank/select structure, so category fit is loose. Recent commits (May 2025) are documentation edits; the author does not state the project is finished.

notes: Every number in claimed_speedup checked against the page tables; all correct. maintenance_status changed from finished to stale: last commit 2025-05-11 is about 17 months before today and no completion statement was found. 161 stars and the vcpkg port (ports/darts-clone, BSD-2-Clause) confirmed.
